description: Request a payout of withdrawable agent earnings ($10 minimum, sent in USDC on Base by default) — requires agent api_key and register_wallet. Only one payout can be in flight at a time; use get_payout_history to check status.

currency.description: Payout network ticker (default: usdcbase (USDC on Base)). Others: usdcsol, usdcarb, usdcop, usdcmatic, usdc, usdtsol, usdtarb, usdtbsc, usdtmatic, usdterc20, usdtton, usdttrc20

name: request_payout
title: Request Payout
